consejo.@es: Funciona como adjetivo y adverbio sin cambiar de forma.
consejo.@en: It works as adjective and adverbian without changing shape.

texto.@es: Un adjetivo describe un nombre (**a careful driver** = un conductor cuidadoso). Aquí, el adverbio explica cómo se realiza una acción (**She drives carefully** = ella conduce con cuidado). Muchos adverbios se forman con **-ly**; **fast** puede ser adjetivo (**a fast train**) o adverbio (**The train goes fast**).
texto.@en: An adjective describes a name (**a careful driver** = a careful driver). Here, the adverbian explains how an action is performed (**She drives carefully** = it drives with care). Many adverbs are formed with **-ly**; **fast** can be adjective (**a fast train**) or adverbian (**The train goes fast**).
